coder_notes: Early Phase 1 record. Population is WHO grade IV glioma without IDH requirement (title and conditions say high-grade/glioma, summary says glioblastoma), coded gbm_only with historical terminology per D27C. Only agent is temozolomide in a new early post-surgical bridge schedule before standard chemoradiation (rule 6), so no candidate. Standard chemoradiation afterwards is not a registered intervention.
